$comment: Motion library: every scene component, its purpose, status and where it has been used. Approval status refers to the CLIENT's approval of the treatment. Updated by the pipeline/Director when lessons are produced.

components.name: SectionTitle
components.purpose: Chapter opener at real teaching transitions
components.character: Outlined oversized numeral, tracked kicker, self-drawing rule, serif title rising word by word; 2% drift

components.name: KineticStatement
components.purpose: A principle stated with typographic weight
components.character: Masked word rise synced to speech; accent italic emphasis; 3.5% push-in

components.name: QuietReflection
components.character: Near-still; soft focus-pull reveal; single accent dot

components.name: StepsDiagram
components.character: Single path travels node to node, arriving as each step is spoken; focus on current step; vertical in portrait

components.name: ConnectionMetaphor
components.purpose: Relationship between two people or ideas
components.character: Two whole circles converge; shared space lit, forms never merge

components.name: Comparison
components.character: Divider draws; columns arrive with narration; preferred side focuses last

components.name: Takeaway
components.character: Numbered points accumulate with drawn rules as they are spoken
